limitations: Whether MS375-48/52/56/60 are four mice or four fractions of one mucus sample is not stated; PEAKS grouped all eight files as one sample 'WT GF 8 weeks'. They are annotated as four sources with biological replicates 1–4.

'8 weeks' in the PEAKS label and '_w8' in the file names may be age or time after an intervention (the cited source study colonised germ-free mice over time), so age is 'not available'; 'germ-free' rests on the PEAKS label 'WT GF'. The mouse strain and sex are not stated in the saved evidence.
PEAKS allowed one non-specific cleavage (semi-tryptic) to find PH-peptides; SDRF has no column for enzyme specificity, so only Trypsin is annotated.
